description: Every BeamNG Lua call the mod relies on. Each row generates one wrapper in beamng/mod/lua/ge/extensions/beamls/gen/bngapi.lua that runs the body in pcall, logs the first failure with the row id, and returns the fallback. That log is the in-game oracle for this sheet: after one session, every row without a 'bngapi FAIL <id>' line is verified. vm=vehicle rows are code strings the GE side sends with veh:queueLuaCommand.

columns.vm: ge (game engine Lua) or vehicle (vehicle Lua, sent as a string)
columns.body: Lua statements; may use the args; return the result
columns.source: Where the API is known from: beammp (read, AGPL, facts only), beamngpy (MIT), docs, guess
columns.fallback: Lua expression returned when the call fails

local s = socket.udp()
return s

rows.notes: BeamMP uses TCP from the same module; UDP is the same library.

rows.body:
local q = quatFromDir(-veh:getDirectionVector(), veh:getDirectionVectorUp())
return q.x, q.y, q.z, q.w
rows.purpose: Car rotation (BeamNG convention: forward -Y)
rows.notes: quatFromDir(dir, up) builds a rotation whose +Y is dir; with dir = -forward this is BeamNG's vehicle frame.
